results.label: 1-year, 15m, short-history, EXPLORATORY

feeBps.note: X1 and the rule, stop, or window-end exit are taker legs. Dollar net uses the same bps, charged on entry notional.

sizing.costNote: C is 2 times (90 + s_bt). The spread stays in the fill.

results.intrabar: stop first; A's daily chandelier moves after the 15m bar that completes the UTC day
results.trail: highest daily close since entry minus 3 times that day's Wilder ATR14
results.stops: A's initial stop and B's disaster stop use daily Wilder ATR14. The 1h Wilder ATR14 is only the stop-fill deduction.
results.nLabel: after slots, caps, clusters, and halts

bootstrap.blocks: non-overlapping 7-day blocks aligned to Monday 00:00 UTC
bootstrap.zeroTradeWeeks: counted as $0 in the dollar bounds
bootstrap.bounds: U80 is p80 and L80 is p20

purge.rule: A trade belongs to its entry fold. IS trades open at the OOS boundary are dropped from both and counted. OOS trades are scored to their real exit. A trade open at the window end is marked to the last 15m close and flagged. Embargo is 0.

selection.statistic: highest L80 of the expanding IS mean net dollars per month at fixed caps
selection.tieBreak: higher IS total net dollars after rounding to $0.01, then registration order

concentration.dollarShare: share of the sum of gross dollars on the stitched OOS

blocked.note: A rejected attempt increments every gate that failed. Hits belong to each config's full-window book. Beta weight is max(beta, 0). A missing beta is 1 and the cap is applied.

holm.pValue: one-sided t test that mean OOS realized net R is above zero, on the stitched book. The same test is on the stress row.

maxOfN.note: 7 stays the trial count. It is not 8.

resolvedDefaults.text: The 30-day sub-1R exit fills at the next 00:00 UTC open minus s_bt.
The 10-day exit's next open is the 15m bar that opens at 00:00 UTC.
B's signal is the Sunday-dated daily bar that closes Monday 00:00. The entry is Monday 01:00.
B's held-set exit fills at the Monday 01:00 open minus s_bt.
A's 10-day exit is first evaluated at the first daily close after the entry date. The lookback still uses the prior 10 daily closes, including days before the entry.
Beta-weighted notional is the sum of max(beta, 0) times notional. A negative beta does not offset long exposure.
A name with fewer than 60 return days takes that month's highest signed member beta. If no member has a beta, the fallback is 1. The cap is never skipped.
After the stop moves, exit cost is one taker leg, 90 plus s_bt, on units times the current stop.
The $1,200 class backstop is the drawdown from the class peak cumulative net dollars, alongside the 20R kill.
The pair backstop is that pair's equity, realized net plus the open mark, at or below -$500.
Daily and weekly halt losses are the drop from equity at the UTC day start and at Monday 00:00.
Average linkage merges two clusters only when every member pair has a 60-day rho and the mean is at least 0.80. An equal mean merges the lexicographically earliest pair of cluster ids.
The $20 paper minimum applies to a null or non-positive lower-80% Kelly bound. A small positive fraction may size below $20.

Pauses may shrink a class to $20 and, for 2b, block new entries. The 1d kill, the 20R kill, and the dollar backstops stop the class at any size. Flag-only at $20 applies to pauses only. Breadth does not resize or block.

sigma = 1.5R until 20 forward trades, then frozen at the realized SD of net R over trades 1-20; Wald +/- ln 4, H0 +0.25R vs H1 0, report-only. Report both LLR paths (the frozen-realized path and the fixed 1.5R path).
The 2b block is 14 calendar dates beginning on the condition date.
G2 concurrency is measured in the post-hash rerun. The pre-hash field stays empty.

Breadth state uses entry-day membership, the prior close, and hysteresis. It starts off. A share from 25 percent through 35 percent keeps the prior state. Option (c) logs the state and does not use it.

comparison.label: CONTAMINATED
comparison.reason: The R1 cluster rule was chosen after the capped P5 results were seen. This historical book is exploratory. Forward paper after the v3.1 hash is the evidence.
comparison.clusterRule: average linkage, rho >= 0.80, members only, fewer than 60 return days stay alone, max 3 open, recomputed on month starts and fold starts
comparison.registeredClusterRule: single linkage, rho >= 0.80 on 60 shared in-window return dates, max 2 open, recomputed on month starts. A boundary-saved name with fewer than 60 in-window days stays alone. The rest of the engine is the same v3.1 book.

concentration.dollarShare: share of the sum of gross dollars on the stitched OOS
